title: Veṇḍu
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Veṇḍu devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || 2. Sukhitā va te manujā || Sugataṃ payirūpāsiya || yuñja Gotamasāsane || appamattānusikkhare ti || || Ye me pavutte satthipade || (Veṇḍūti Bhagavā) anusikkhanti jhāyino || kāle te appamajjantā || na maccuvasaṅgā siyun ti || ||
